title: Equal stage-section images become equal after one refinement.
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. On each $F(j)$ let $P_j$ be a precoverage with singleton isomorphism covers, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and pullbacks along covering arrows [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume each covering presieve has finitely many distinct arrows. Assume transition functors preserve covering presieves and covering pullbacks, are continuous for the generated topologies, and their set-valued inverse-image functors preserve finite limits. Let $V$ be a cocone such that its object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. On $C=V.pt$ let $Q$ be a precoverage with singleton isomorphism covers, stability under finite composition and finite base change, and covering pullbacks. Assume its covering presieves are exactly the transported images of stage covering presieves, and every $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$, a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and $U\in F(i)$. Set $G_t=F(t.hom)_sG$ and $S_t=G_t(F(t.hom)U)$ for $t=(i\to j)$ in $\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and set $H=V_{i,s}G$, $T=H(V_iU)$. Suppose $\alpha_t:G_t\to V_j^sH$ is a family of sheaf maps whose composites with the stage unit at every $X\in F(i)$ equal the limit unit at $X$ in the arrow category. Let $D:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{Set}$ be a diagram, $E_t:D(t)\cong S_t$ isomorphisms, $K$ a cocone on $D$, and $e:K.pt\cong T$ an isomorphism. Assume $eK_t=\alpha_tE_t$ as arrow-category objects for every $t$. Suppose additionally that sheaf maps $\theta_b:G_t\to F(b.right)^sG_{t'}$ are given for $b:t\to t'$, and their composites with the stage unit at every $X\in F(i)$ equal the unit at $t'$ in the arrow category. Assume $\theta_bE_t=E_{t'}D(b)$ as arrow-category objects. For every $t$ and $x,y\in D(t)$ with $K_t(x)=K_t(y)$ there exist $t'$ and one arrow $b:t\to t'$ such that $D(b)(x)=D(b)(y)$. No existence of representatives for arbitrary elements of the apex is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the raw stage presheaf diagram B by Kan extension with universal units beta and compatible maps gamma to the underlying limit inverse image. For each stage, use Kan uniqueness to identify B_t with the chosen raw Kan extension. Composition of the two sheaf inverse-image adjunctions gives its canonical sheafified comparison isomorphism. Injectivity of the composite adjunction hom equivalence and halpha identify sheafification of gamma_t with that isomorphism, followed by the inverse sheafification counit. Thus sheafification of each gamma_t is an isomorphism. These component isomorphisms give a natural isomorphism from the sheafified B diagram to the constant sheafified target diagram. Under i is filtered, hence connected and nonempty. Transport the constant colimit cocone through that natural isomorphism. Sheafification preserves the source colimit, so uniqueness of colimits proves that its colimit descent phi becomes an isomorphism after sheafification. Both formal comparison arguments are proved in Lean in private helpers.

proof.text: The finite-cover argument proves that colimit B is a sheaf. The limit inverse image is also a sheaf. Their sheafification units are isomorphisms. Unit naturality identifies phi followed by the target unit with the source unit followed by sheafification of phi. All maps other than phi are isomorphisms, so phi is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The raw evaluation formula gives a genuine set-colimit cocone R for D and q from its apex to evaluation of colimit B. Its coprojection equation followed by phi and the given h-iota equation identify K_t followed by e with R_t followed by q and phi. Apply e to K_t(x)=K_t(y), then cancel the injective maps phi and q to obtain R_t(x)=R_t(y). Apply the same-stage filtered-set colimit equality criterion to R to obtain one refinement b making D(b)(x)=D(b)(y).

theorem colimit_site_set_section_eventual_equality
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck)]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ Type u)
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (K : Cocone D)
    (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hι : ∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))))
    (hm : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) :
    ∀ (t : Under i) (x y : D.obj t), K.ι.app t x = K.ι.app t y →
      ∃ (t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'), D.map b x = D.map b y
